description: Create the quote in the contractor's connected Jobber account, as a draft they review and send from Jobber. Only call after the contractor explicitly confirms the draft. Requires a client name; ask for it (plus email and job site address if known) when missing. Side effects: creates a new quote in Jobber, and a new client and property there when no existing client matches; it never edits or deletes existing Jobber records. Safe to retry: a quote that was already pushed returns the existing Jobber quote. Fails if Jobber is not connected or any line has no price.

clientName.description: Customer name, if not already on the quote

siteAddress.description: The customer's job site street address for the Jobber property, if not already on the quote

name: push_quote_to_jobber
title: Push quote to Jobber
